anchor.anchor_text: The treatment works can supply 18 million gallons per day, but the shared transmission main is capped at 14.5 MGD.

anchor.anchor_text: The latest inspected configuration sustained 12.8 MGD after fire-flow and hospital reserve.

anchor.anchor_text: BASTION supplies pressure limits, ECHO supplies feeder headroom, and FALCON supplies treatment output.

claim.statement: DELTA sequencing is constrained by BASTION pressure limits, ECHO feeder headroom, and FALCON treatment output.

anchor.anchor_text: Restoration may advance through 10, 30, 60, and 100 percent demand stages only after two thirty-minute windows meet pressure, turbidity, power, and storage gates.
